definitions.full: H247. azar [ אָזַר ] verb gird, encompass, equip (Talmud id. , Arabic , Aramaic in derivation Lag BN 177 derives from ). Qal Perfect אָֽזְרוּ 1Sam 2:4 ; Imperfect suffix יַאַזְרֵנִי Job 30:18 ; 2 masculine singular תֶּאֱזוֺר Jer 1:17 ; Imperative אֱזָרנָֿא Job 38:3 ; 40:7 ; Passive participle אָזוּר 2Kin 1:8 ; — gird, gird on , followed by accusative of thing loins חֲלָצֶיךָ Job 38:3 ; 40:7 , מָתְנֶיךָ Jer 1:17 ; passive, subject בְּמָתְנָיו אָזור עוֺר וְאֵזוֺר אֵזוֺר, 2Kin 1:8 ; compare active with accusative of person Job 30:18 יַאַזְרֵנִי כֻתָּנְתִּי כְּפִי , subject לְבוּשִׁי see Di; figurative 1Sam 2:4 חַיִל אָֽזְרוּ Niph`al Participle נֶאֱזָר figurative Psa 65:7 of God ( ׳נ בִּגְבוּרֶה ) girded with might. Pi`el Imperfect 2masculine singular suffix וַתְּאַזְּרֵנִי Psa 18:40 ; 30:12 ; וַתַּזְרֵנִי 2Sam 22:40 (Ges § 68 R 2); Participle suffix הַמְּאַזְּרֵנִי Psa 18:33 ; construct מְאַזְּרֵי Isa 50:11 but compare below — gird , with 2 accusative (person & thing) figurative, Psa 18:40 = 2Sam 22:40 ; Psa 18:33 ( חַיִל ); 30:12 ( שִׂמְחָה ); accusative of thing omitted Isa 45:5 ; accusative of person omitted זִיקוֺת מְאַזְּרֵי Isaiah 50:12; but read rather מְאִירֵי compare 27:11 ( ᵑ6 Kn Brd Di). Hithpa`el Perfect הִתְאַזָּ֑ר Psa 93:1 ; Imperative הִתְאַזְּרוּ Isa 8:9 (twice in verse) — gird oneself , for war 8:9 (twice in verse); with עֹז Psa 93:1 (subject ׳י ).
